notes: New in 4.0.2: the internet test no longer says "Unstable" when your IPTV server is fine. Refresh without internet keeps your channel list. One broken line no longer stops a whole playlist from loading. Movies and series load only the category you stop on, and an interrupted update download is detected and fetched again.
notes_en: New in 4.0.2: the internet test no longer says "Unstable" when your IPTV server is fine. Refresh without internet keeps your channel list. One broken line no longer stops a whole playlist from loading. Movies and series load only the category you stop on, and an interrupted update download is detected and fetched again.
notes_sq: E re në 4.0.2: testi i internetit nuk thotë më "Unstable" kur serveri IPTV punon mirë. Refresh pa internet e mban listën e kanaleve. Një rresht i prishur nuk e ndal më gjithë playlist-ën. Filmat dhe serialet ngarkojnë vetëm kategorinë ku ndalesh, dhe përditësimi i shkarkuar përgjysmë vërehet e shkarkohet sërish.
